# gfonts

> Download ‘Google’ fonts (via
> [google-webfonts-helper](https://gwfh.mranftl.com)) and generate CSS
> to use in [rmarkdown](https://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/) documents and
> [shiny](https://shiny.rstudio.com/) applications. Some popular fonts
> are included and ready to use.

## Installation

Install from [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=gfonts) with:

``` r

install.packages("gfonts")
```

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/dreamRs/gfonts) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("dreamRs/gfonts")
```

## Download a font to use it locally

Get the ID of the desired font between **1474** available :

``` r

library(gfonts)
get_all_fonts()
```

Download the files necessary for its use and generate the appropriate
CSS code :

``` r

setup_font(
  id = "roboto",
  output_dir = "path/to"
)
```

Use it in {shiny} or {rmarkdown} :

``` r

use_font("roboto", "www/css/roboto.css")
```

👉 [See detailed
example](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/articles/gfonts.html)

## Included fonts

Some fonts are included in the package and ready to use :

``` r

use_pkg_gfont("roboto")
```

![](reference/figures/included-fonts.png)

👉 [See all fonts
available](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/articles/articles/included-fonts.html)

## Related packages

- Package
  [`googlefontR`](https://github.com/timelyportfolio/googlefontR)
  provides helper functions to ease the use of Google Fonts with R.
- Package [`showtext`](https://github.com/yixuan/showtext) makes it easy
  to use various types of fonts (TrueType, OpenType, Type 1, web fonts,
  etc.) in R graphs.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`download_font()`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/download_font.md)
  : Download font files
- [`generate_css()`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/generate_css.md)
  : Generate CSS to import fonts
- [`get_all_fonts()`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/get_all_fonts.md)
  : Get infos about all fonts available
- [`get_font_info()`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/get_font_info.md)
  : Get detailed information about a font
- [`gfonts`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/gfonts.md) : Use
  Google fonts offline
- [`included_fonts`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/included_fonts.md)
  : Detail about included fonts.
- [`setup_font()`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/setup_font.md)
  : Setup a font to be used in Shiny or Markdown
- [`tag_example()`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/tag_example.md)
  : Generate HTML tags used in examples
- [`use_font()`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/use_font.md)
  : Use a downloaded font in Shiny or Markdown
- [`use_pkg_gfont()`](https://dreamrs.github.io/gfonts/reference/use_pkg_gfont.md)
  : Use a Google Font included in {gfonts}
